verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers ROS 2's core middleware, client libraries, CLI tools, QoS, security, and simulation features, but contains no mention of VLA models, robotics foundation models, or any supported tooling/integration path (e.g., official packages, tutorials, or SDKs) for incorporating such AI models into the autonomy stack. Missing for 10: any documentation or examples of VLA/foundation-model integration, official model-serving nodes, or partner tooling (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac, Hugging Face robotics integrations) referenced by ROS 2 itself.
